programme.title: Ukraine of the Future. Defeat the Aggressor
Battle at Sea
programme.desc: Audiences are taken into the world of naval warfare, examining major battles, strategic operations, and the challenges faced by naval forces. Episodes showcase tactics, coordination, and decision-making behind maritime missions, providing in-depth analysis of military strategies and outcomes. The program highlights the importance of naval power, the impact of maritime conflicts on security, and the human and operational efforts involved in protecting waters and achieving strategic objectives.

programme.title: Face of War
programme.desc: Viewers follow compelling stories from war-affected areas, revealing the human cost of conflict and the resilience of those enduring it. Episodes focus on personal experiences, struggles, and acts of bravery, offering insight into the social and emotional realities of war. The program provides a deeper understanding of how conflict shapes lives, emphasizing courage, survival, and the human spirit in the face of adversity.

programme.title: The Paper City. Kherson a yer after liberation
programme.desc: Surviving months of brutal occupation, the people of Kherson held onto hope, kindness, and unwavering faith in freedom. One year after liberation, this deeply moving documentary shares raw memories from those who endured the darkest days. Through personal stories of defiance, waiting for the Ukrainian Armed Forces, and reviving a devastated city, witness an incredible testament to human resilience, unity, and an indestructible spirit.

programme.title: Doctors
programme.desc: War is not just a line of fire, but a continuous battle for every heartbeat. Documentary project "Doctors" tells the story of those who changed sterile operating rooms to smoky trenches, and white coats to military pixels. This is a story about titanic medics who, under fire, snatch their comrades from the hands of death. You will see the true value of every second, where professionalism borders on superhuman courage, and saving lives becomes the highest form of victory.

programme.title: The Last Day of the Dictator
Flying for Two
programme.desc: Extending beyond a simple flight, this touching story reveals a powerful bond shaped by memory and meaning. "Flying for Two" follows a journey where one person honors another's dream, carrying it forward through courage and dedication. Along the way, themes of sacrifice, love, and remembrance unfold with growing intensity, as the past continues to echo in the present. Through intimate moments and a steadily building narrative, the film captures how hope can rise even in the face of loss, offering a deeply emotional and unforgettable experience.

programme.title: The Russian octopus: how the Kremlin influences the World
programme.desc: Moscow's influence reaches far beyond its borders, using cultural diplomacy, hidden networks, and strategic pressure to shape global opinions. This investigative documentary exposes how Kremlin propaganda operates across European capitals—bypassing sanctions, infiltrating public discourse, and weaponizing soft power. Uncover the mechanics of a global web designed to weaken international support for Ukraine and subvert democracy.
